name: Allow Disconnect
summary: Adds a disconnect button to server loading screens so when u r stuck on a loading screen you can use the button to disconnect from the server
description:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6231055c2e8036a16adcd8baffa2750087e90c72_0.webp)

Stuck in a loading terrain screen again? Fear no more, allow disconnect will allow you to exit that screen!

### Features:
 - Adds a button called disconnect to every server pause screen (like downloading terrain)
- Allows you to disconnect from server while downloading terrain or getting stuck on one of those pause pages.

### Image:
![Gallyer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56071a958314f801bd2337dc32079bf65da7f8f5.png)

![Modernpic1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad43a857cf7cf960889c3c9d0e90bef7ad187d88_0.webp)

![pic2modern](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03239e884bba49c203b937345bbdf7672aec5f82_0.webp)
author: Sekai0ni0Itamio
